text: During June 24-26, 2026, learned that HTML scraping of Bing works from OCI without API key; DuckDuckGo API does not work from OCI cloud IPs; SearXNG Docker has permissions and SELinux issues on ARM64/OL9 (deferred to V2.0); Typst (~16MB) is optimal for PDF generation and Pandoc (~40MB) converts Markdown to Typst; and implemented token optimization strategies (truncation to 4K chars per input, scoring-based prioritization, progressive refinement).

Entre el 24 y 26 de junio de 2026 se aprendió que el scraping HTML de Bing funciona desde OCI sin API key; la API de DuckDuckGo no funciona desde IPs cloud de OCI; SearXNG Docker tiene problemas de permisos y SELinux en ARM64/OL9 (diferido a V2.0); Typst (~16MB) es óptimo para generar PDF y Pandoc (~40MB) convierte Markdown a Typst; y se implementaron estrategias de optimización de tokens (truncado a 4K chars/entrada, priorización por puntuación, refinamiento progresivo). | When: 24-26 de junio de 2026
entities: OCI, ARM64, Researchit, Docker, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Pandoc, Typst, SearXNG, OL9

text: Between June 24 and 26, 2026, key decisions were made: prioritize absolute stability, replace SearXNG with direct Bing scraping from OCI (rate limited to 1 request per 2 seconds), integrate Reddit via Composio MCP, adopt Typst+Pandoc as definitive PDF generator (discarding WeasyPrint and Puppeteer), avoid DuckDuckGo from OCI, and configure PDF in mobile-friendly format (DejaVu Sans 15pt, margins 2.2cm, line-height 1.2em).

Entre el 24 y 26 de junio de 2026 se tomaron decisiones clave: priorizar estabilidad absoluta, usar scraping directo de Bing desde OCI sin API key (rate limiting 1 req/2s) en lugar de SearXNG, integrar Reddit vía Composio MCP, adoptar Typst+Pandoc como generador PDF definitivo (descartando WeasyPrint y Puppeteer), evitar DuckDuckGo desde OCI, y configurar PDF formato mobile-friendly (DejaVu Sans 15pt, márgenes 2.2cm, interlineado 1.2em). | When: 24-26 de junio de 2026

Typst is the best option for generating PDFs from markdown on ARM64/OL9, already implemented, but MD to Typst conversion is fragile; Pandoc (binary ~40MB for ARM64) can convert MD to Typst, avoiding manual conversion; WeasyPrint and Puppeteer/Chromium are too heavy for 12GB RAM; recommended approach: install Pandoc for conversion and keep Typst for PDF compilation.
